name: HJ v2 stage B gate: learned policy safety value V (PNCBF + lambda-Reachability) vs the trend rule, held-out
written: 2026-10-23 ~23:20, before any value net was trained and before the held-out data exist
training: eval/hj_value2.py train on paired_record_s4 paired_cbfg_s4 paired_record_h2h2 paired_cbfg_h2h2 (eval/hj_data2.py data; no labels used); CFG LAMBDA 0.9, DELTA 0.97, 40 epochs, 10% episodes for early stopping. Margin: negG_max (stage A tie-break; exploratory continuation, see stageA_protocol result); neg_log_sens_4 trained the same way as declared secondary.
held_out: paired_record_m3 (policy-alone arm of the margin test, episodes 19500-19799; never used for any design): margin_check decision set (topple windows kt-10..kt + every 4th episode without a topple).
reference: trend rule (relative d<=2x or o>O_MAX, OR d fell since the previous decision and relative d<=4x) on the same decisions, from eval/margin_check.py MC_RUN=paired_record_m3 MC_TAG=_m3.
primary: tau = the quantile of V on the held-out safe decisions equal to the trend rule's alarm rate there; PASS if the share of topple episodes warned >= 3 chunks ahead (first alarm within kt-8..kt) by V < tau exceeds the trend rule's share.
secondary: AUC of -V at 1-3 and 4-6 chunks before vs safe decisions; the neg_log_sens_4 value.
next_if_pass: stage C (V in the G-CEM certificate), pre-registered separately.

result.primary: FAIL for both margins: at the trend rule's held-out safe alarm rate (12.97%), topples warned >= 3 chunks ahead: trend rule 83.3%, V(negG_max) 58.3%, V(neg_log_sens_4) 66.7% (60 topple episodes, 3327 decisions of paired_record_m3)
result.secondary: V ranks better than its stage-A margin: AUC topple in 1-3 / 4-6 chunks 0.831 / 0.767 (negG_max; margin alone 0.775 / 0.657) and 0.843 / 0.778 (neg_log_sens_4; 0.787 / 0.653)
result.next: stage C (V in the certificate) not run, per next_if_pass
